relationships.subject: morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: For the hot plate, morphine pups displayed thermal hyperalgesia as evidenced by a shorter latency to elicit a nociceptive response (Figure 2A).

key_findings: Neonatal morphine from P1-P14 downregulated myelination and oligodendrocyte differentiation genes (including Mag, Mbp, Plp1) in the NAc.
Neonatal morphine caused thermal hyperalgesia but no long-term adult behavioral effects.
